name: Icon button
purpose: An icon-only control that triggers a single action where space is tight or the action is universally recognised (add, download, edit, search, close). Shares Button's four-level emphasis hierarchy (primary / secondary / tertiary / quaternary) and its tokens, but carries no visible label — so it must supply an accessible name and guarantee a 44x44 target. Use a labelled Button when the action is not unambiguous from a glyph alone.

props.name: type
props.$note: Emphasis mirrors Button. Quaternary (ghost) is the most common icon-button in toolbars/inputs; primary icon-only is rare (reserve for a single decisive action e.g. a FAB-like add).

props.name: glyph
props.$note: Icon id from the assets/icons sprite; drives the accessible name unless aria-label overrides.

props.name: label
props.$note: REQUIRED accessible name (aria-label / visually-hidden text). Icon-only = no visible label, so the name is non-optional (4.1.2 / 2.4.4).

variants.name: primary
variants.use: Highest-emphasis icon-only action; solid MONOCHROME fill (Apollo Mono — NO red, B-D1), inverse glyph, hover = operational 0.70 opacity. Rare — one per view.

variants.name: secondary
variants.use: Alternative icon action; inverting solid fill.

variants.name: tertiary
variants.use: Outlined icon button on a white fill.

variants.name: quaternary
variants.use: Ghost icon button — the toolbar/input-adornment default; transparent, tints on hover/press.

primary.$note: Mono monochrome (no red); glyph = icon/on-inverse; hover renders as 0.70 opacity (ADR-0009/B-D3).

tokens.$darkDecisions: Inherits Button's decisions verbatim (same bindings): secondary + primary-pressed glyph = text/on-inverse (#FFF light / #333 dark) to avoid white-on-light; tertiary/border/default dark = #767676 (>=3:1). Disabled glyph is contrast-exempt.
tokens.$finding: (2026-07-14) Glyphs in the proof snippet are inline line-SVGs. Gate-green requires rebasing onto the assets/icons/ <symbol> sprite (icon-source rule; _validate_icons.py rejects UNKNOWN + circle/rect-only). Same path Notifications took 2026-06-24. Logged, not swept.
tokens.$disabledGlyphDecision: (2026-07-14, Dave) The disabled glyph must stay VISIBLE. Original bind (icon/disabled #D7D8D6) equalled tertiary/background/disabled (#D7D8D6) → glyph vanished (empty box). Rebound all disabled glyphs to tertiary/text/disabled (#B7B7B7 light / #767676 dark) — muted but never equal to the disabled surface. Motion also softened per Dave: hover = +2px, press = -2px on the 44px target (was scale 1.08 / .92).
tokens.$glyphPresenceGate: (2026-07-14, Dave ask) NEW gate to build — _validate_glyph_presence: for icon-only components, every glyph must be distinguishable from its own surface in EVERY state incl. disabled (resolve glyph vs surface light+dark; FAIL below ~1.3:1). A presence floor distinct from the 3:1 non-text-contrast gate — disabled is contrast-exempt but must still be present. Manifest carries the glyphPresence pairs. Wire into _build_all after the batch.

motion.reducedMotion: Transforms + brightness disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; static colour states convey everything.

responsive.rule: Intrinsically fixed at the 44x44 target; does not reflow. Groups of icon buttons (a toolbar) are the responsive unit and wrap/collapse per their container.

mustNotNeighbour: Icon button (primary) x2 (a second primary icon action)

accessibility.name: MANDATORY accessible name via aria-label or visually-hidden text — icon-only has no visible label (4.1.2 Name, Role, Value / 2.4.4). A tooltip is not a substitute for the name.
accessibility.keyboard: Reachable in tab order; Enter/Space activate.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus outline (text/default), never removed without replacement.
accessibility.target: Hit area >= 44x44 CSS px even when the glyph is 20px — padding/box makes the target (2.5.8).
accessibility.nonText: Glyph is non-text content: >= 3:1 against its background (1.4.11), and meaning must not rest on the glyph alone where ambiguous (pair with tooltip/label).

antiPatterns: Icon button with no accessible name (no aria-label / visually-hidden text)
Disabled (or any-state) glyph bound to a token equal to its own surface — the icon disappears and the control reads empty (glyph-presence gate)
Hit area smaller than 44x44 because the glyph is small
Using an ambiguous glyph as the only action affordance without a tooltip/label
More than one primary icon button in a single context
Hard-coded colour instead of a token binding
REVIEW (inferred): using an icon button where a labelled Button is clearer (unfamiliar action)

tokenValidation.against: token store (semantic-colour.json) — bindings inherited from Button.meta (gated green)
tokenValidation.result: PROVISIONAL — reuses Button's live on-light/on-dark bindings verbatim (primary/*, secondary/*, tertiary/*, icon/*, text/on-inverse). Same deprecated-on-dark migration applies as Button. Icon-source rebase pending ($finding).
tokenValidation.$note: Pro-forma proof component; promote after gate-green rebase + Dave review.
